root_cause: A syntactically complete ruleset proposal or fixture transcript can be mistaken for native provider enforcement even when actor provenance, signed receipts, exact rule binding, denied-ref immutability, positive App merge and rollback were not independently observed.
correction: Adopt pure fail-closed reviewers for the exact ruleset proposal and transcript shape. Every result keeps providerEnforced, mutationAuthority and activationAuthorized false; production identity and repository are rejected.
prevention_rule: Never activate an exclusive writer from serialized proposal or transcript shape. Require native fixture repository identity, dedicated App identity, distinct signed attempt receipts, unchanged refs for every denial, exact-head green positive merge, baseline restoration, protected delivery and separately reviewed issuer/consumer authorization.

limits: No production ruleset or permission change

activation.next_gate: separately reviewed native fixture-only issuer and consumer with exact signed receipts
